title: Config
description: Settings of `botica lint`: `botica.toml`, or the `[tool.botica]` table of `pyproject.toml`.

code-dirs.description:
Where the code of the project lives, as directories from its root grouped by ecosystem
(`python`, `js`, `rust`, `go`, `jvm`), for the rules about layout. When absent they are
detected; an empty table says there are none.

compat-ast-grep-ignore.description:
While migrating from ast-grep: honour `# ast-grep-ignore: <rule>` on the line of a finding and
on the line before it.

extend-exclude.description: Globs of paths to skip, in addition to what `.gitignore` already skips.

external.description: Globs of rule IDs that suppressions may name without a warning even when they are unknown.

ignore.description: Rules to switch off. Same syntax as `select`.

languages.description: Restrict the run to these languages (empty means every language).

preview.description: Also run the rules whose status is `preview`.

replace.description: Rule to replace -> rule that replaces it.

rule-dirs.description: Directories with the project's own rules.

rules.description: Settings per rule, keyed by slug, code or alias.

select.description: Rules to run: `default`, `all`, a family (`BTSTRUC`), a code prefix (`BTSTRUC0`), a code, a slug or `tag:<tag>`.

CatalogSource.description: A catalog of rules that lives on disk.

path.description: Directory of the catalog, relative to the directory of this file.

Override.description: Changes for the files that match `files`, applied in order.

RuleConfig.description: Settings of one rule. Any other key is an option declared by that rule.

ignores.description: Replaces the default `ignores` of the rule (`[]` clears them).
